thread:
anya: Quick postmortem follow-up — we still have 3 outstanding remediations: missing spans in the tracer pipeline, wrong aggregation buckets in analytics, and lagging ETL for metrics. Need owners + timelines. Proposing owners below, please confirm or reassign.

Derek: I'll take the ETL lag remediation (investigate pipeline backpressure + retry logic). Target: initial fix in 5 business days, rollout + monitor in 2 weeks. @mohit will you help with tracing changes?

Mohit: yep. I can own the tracing/spans patch. Quick note: found pattern where batcher drops last micro-batch when partial failure happens. Patch idea: make emitter ack on write before dropping. Will prototype in 48h.

Tara: I'll own the aggregation correctness. Plan: add unit tests for bucketing, add end-to-end validation job that compares old vs new results daily. ETA: tests + PR in 1 week, e2e job in 3 weeks.

anya: thanks. Action items summary: 1) ETL lag — derek — 5d prototype. 2) Missing spans — mohit — 2d prototype. 3) Bad aggregation — tara — 7d tests. 4) Add alerting + regression harness — team — 14d. Add tickets and link to postmortem.

ops-bot: Created ticket INC-4721 for ETL lag (derek). Created ticket INC-4722 for missing spans (mohit). Created ticket INC-4723 for aggregation (tara).

Derek: adding alert: set SLO for 95th latency on ETL ingest < 500ms and alert if > 75% of shards exceed threshold for 5m.

Mohit: SQL check I used to detect missing spans:
```
-- quick sanity: find traces with fewer spans than expected
SELECT trace_id, expected_span_count, count(*) AS seen
FROM trace_metadata JOIN spans USING(trace_id)
WHERE ts > now() - interval '24 hours'
GROUP BY trace_id, expected_span_count
HAVING count(*) < expected_span_count;
```

Tara: for aggregations I saw off-by-one from window boundary float rounding. Proposed fix: switch to integer bucket boundaries and add replay test. Putting follow-up notes in INC-4723.

Anya: recurring pattern note: we've seen similar ETL + aggregation issues 3 times in last 6 months (refs: INC-3912, INC-4189). Need a recurrence mitigation: monthly incident review + automated regression suite.

Derek: +1 to monthly review. I'll add a calendar entry for recurring review and link tickets.

Mohit: suggest adding a nightly check that validates span counts versus ingested events; failing job should open alert.

ops-bot: Scheduled check-in meeting "obs-remediations" every Monday 10:00 AM starting next week.

Tara: I'll own cross-team comms and QA signoff once tests land. Will update INC-4723 with QA checklist.

Anya: Great. Please update the tickets with PR links and set due dates. We'll reconvene next Monday for status. :thumbsup:

Derek: ack

Mohit: ack

Tara: ack
